title: Dropped
description: As the fog passes, the outline of the crew appears exactly where the ram bedded last.

title: Dropped
description: The men leave sheep country but face a 22-hour trail ride to Tom-Tom.

title: Dropped
description: Decisions made in the Yukon can make or break any situation in a second and are magnified in this rugged terrain; the brothers ascend and stalk the mountain grizzly and are now within 500 yards; the decision rests with Chris.

title: Dropped
description: The snow continues to pommel the Keefer brothers at Church Camp and visibility is at an all-time low; they are snowed in and have no definite timetable to continue the hunt; problems begin to arise.

title: Dropped
description: As the bull closes in on the calling, Chris can hear the bull but cannot see him, Casey, on the other hand, can; as they try to communicate using hand signals, the bull disappears over the mountain top and gone.

title: Dropped
description: Chris closes the distance to 300 yards and drops the big bull.

title: Dropped
description: The brothers move toward the bull; midway through the stalk, the bull walks toward them.

title: Love of the Wild
description: An exploration of the diverse wildlife that shares these rugged environments; we delve into the coexistence between humans and wildlife, revealing the mutual respect and careful balance required to thrive in these ecosystems.

title: Love of the Wild
description: During the summer months, life is transformed under the perpetual daylight of the Arctic and northern regions; in Finland, Aki and Emilia experience the midnight sun; Morgan and Tone in Norway take advantage of extended daylight for hunting.

title: Love of the Wild
description: The naturalists reflect on the importance of preserving cultural practices that date back generations; from falconry in Austria to fishing in Finland, examining how each person stays connected to ancient techniques.

title: Love of the Wild
description: As autumn turns to winter, the naturalists prepare for the harsh conditions ahead; the preparations each naturalist undertakes to endure the intense cold, whether by stocking food, reinforcing shelters.

title: Love of the Wild
description: The naturalists share how climate change impacts their environments and the traditions they cherish; with shifting weather patterns and the decline of certain wildlife populations, each individual faces new challenges in their respective regions.

title: Love of the Wild
description: A reflection on the connection each naturalist shares with the wild places they call home; stories of resilience, survival and dedication to nature; as they look forward, each naturalist reflects on the profound.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Mario risks it all by rafting down the deadliest strip of water in Africa, the Zambezi River, towards Lake Kariba, only to find himself in front of some of the biggest and baddest problematic man-eating crocodiles on the planet.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Mario was told by locals that deep in the Namibian desert there is an odd-looking creature.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: In the Kalahari Desert, there is an ancient tribe lives off the land.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Just off the coast of Africa is a strip of 115 islands called the Seychelles; Mario educates his audience as to how to fish reefs; species like bonefish and milk fish are caught for fun and Mario even attempts to swim with sailfish.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Mario explores the coast of Cape Town, where the Indian Ocean meets the Atlantic, and tries to catch yellowfin tuna.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Deep in the wilderness of Northern South Africa, poaching is rife, and the wilderness is as dangerous as it gets; Mario attempts to be the first in the area to have ever harvested one of the most dangerous animals known to Africa, the Cape buffalo.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: The Axis deer populations in Hawaii have reached plague proportions, and they are in fact invasive to this beautifully pristine archipelago of the Pacific.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Mario links up with Frank Stallone and ventures off to Kansas in search of Eastern turkeys. With Frank's Italian background, Mario insists that it's possible to make turkey meatballs that taste amazing.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Former UFC Lightweight Champion and Hall of Famer Chuck Liddell and Mario take on the mountain tops of Idaho on horseback. The two are on a search for a mysterious piece of protein.

title: Man Eats Wild
description: Mario travels to the outer limits of the Eastern Coast of Canada to a place called Prince Edward Island; home to some of the biggest bluefin tuna on the planet, these fish can grow up to 1,000 pounds.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel heads to Kentucky to harvest 17-year periodical cicadas with Dr. Jonathan Larson.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel travels to the Bamberger Ranch Preserve outside of Austin to hunt feral hogs at night.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel embarks on a journey to the Standing Rock Reservation and visits the native-owned bison ranch there; he and his wife Avani have the chance to experience the bison hunt and share in a traditional Dakota meal.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel travels to Canada's easternmost point of land, the island of Newfoundland; he obtains the guidance of local game cook and forager, Laurie McCarthy.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel teams up with Mike Kimmel -- aka the "Python Cowboy" -- for a night expedition to combat the Burmese python invasion in the Florida Everglades; alligators and snake bites aren't enough to stop him from having a python dinner.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel learns how hard it is to catch a giant Atlantic tuna; his perseverance ends in sushi dinner.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel puts down the rifle and picks up his bow as he heads off to the desert of Arizona in search of javelina; he samples several desert plants, including ephedra and juniper in a quest to make a backcountry meal.

title: WildFed
description: Daniel joins Maine guide, Randy Huntley, as they trap beaver in freezing temperatures; chef Kate Gooding prepares a recipe from her cookbook, "50 Ways To Eat a Beaver" for Randy, Daniel, and his wife Avani.

title: WildFed
description: Chef Tony Seichrist hosts Daniel in Savannah, Georgia to hunt invasive hogs, fish for sheepshead and sea bass, and to taste their way around the region.

title: Emergency
description: The Lunar New Year is a very busy time of the year for health professionals in Vietnam, the ones taking place in Sydney are invariably mentioned and New South Wales Ambulance's paramedics don't have a minute to spare to enjoy the festivities.

title: Emergency
description: In Mumbai, more than half of its inhabitants live in slums, the conditions create various public health problems; in Buenos Aires, ambulances refuse to enter the narrow streets of some of the capital's villas.

title: Wardens
description: Montana Game Wardens try to control the masses as antler hunters search for their trophies.

title: Wardens
description: Montana Game Wardens work the opening day of pronghorn season.

title: Wardens
description: Montana Game Wardens deal with the opening day of deer season.

title: Wardens
description: Montana Game Wardens deal with water issues including littering, underage drinking and the annual Yellowstone Boat Float.

title: Wardens
description: Repeat offenders and people with outstanding warrants.

title: Wardens
description: Game wardens search for poachers with a little help from full size decoys and local citizens.

title: Wardens
description: Wardens track a potential poacher who took a deer out of season; a warden as he takes his son hunting.

title: Wardens
description: Wardens deal with a trespassing incident and an early hunting violation in Montana.

title: Wardens
description: Nick Taylor looks for out-of-town hunters accused of trespassing and illegally killing a mule deer; Lee Burrows responds to a panicked deer hunter calling about a kill.

title: Wardens
description: The wardens investigate a possible elk harassment case and possible poaching in Montana.

title: Wardens
description: Nick Taylor responds to a call about duck hunters shooting over thin ice; Bryan Golie keeps an eye on the Bear Tooth Game Range on opening day of elk season.

title: Wardens
description: Joe Kambic sets up an elk decoy to help nab illegal hunters; Kqyn Kuka tries to save a deer in the river.

title: Wardens
description: Bryan Golie is after suspicious hunters during elk hunting season in Montana; Paul Luepke deals with hunters who shot mule deer does without proper permits.

title: Wardens
description: Warden Jon Obst checks recreational boaters for life vests; Warden Kyle Miller keeps campers informed on guidelines.

title: Wardens
description: The Wardens are out checking fishermen for licenses.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom and his daughter, Kia, are on the mighty Salmon River, doing some underwater metal detecting and looking for gold nuggets.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom Massie and his daughter Kia travel along the Oregon Trail in search of the legendary Blue Bucket Mine.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom Massie is joined by his son Kael as he travels underneath a massive glacier in hopes of detecting some gold nuggets.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom and his daughter Kia retrace old footsteps by paying a visit to the old Pine Log property in Calif.

title: Gold Fever
description: Join Tom Massie and his daughter Kia for a day of sluicing in Eastern Oregon, searching for gold nuggets.

title: Gold Fever
description: Join Tom and his son, Kael, as they dredge in Anchorage, trying to find some gold for Cindy's birthday gift.

title: Gold Fever
description: With the drought in California, Tom and his daughter Kia sail down the Stanislaus River, searching for gold that would otherwise be too deep to find underwater.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom and his daughter Kia are out in the desert exploring old mine shafts.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom and Kia are out metal detecting in the desert looking for the lost Peg Leg Treasure.

title: Gold Fever
description: It's summertime in Alaska so Tom and Kia are making the most of the twenty-four hours of daylight.

title: Gold Fever
description: It's a big year for the Cripple River mining camp in Nome, Alaska; the crew is extremely busy, and the participants are already finding some of the biggest gold in recent history.

title: Gold Fever
description: Tom's been dredging a spot on Arctic Creek for the past couple of years; now is the time he and Kia are going to open the hole up in hopes of finding some serious gold.

title: First on Scene
description: Police pursue an enraged offender who leads them on a chase even though his car has just three wheels; things turn deadly when he pulls an automatic rifle on officers.

title: First on Scene
description: A frantic husband attempts to rush his pregnant wife to hospital when she suddenly goes into labor; the baby has other ideas and decides to enter the world on the side of a busy highway.

title: First on Scene
description: Cops in Arizona swarm to save a baby from a machine-gun wielding maniac; nine of them are shot in their selfless rescue.

title: First on Scene
description: Performance car enthusiasts illegally block city streets and intersections before recklessly performing burnouts in the middle of thousands of onlookers.

title: First on Scene
description: Heart-stopping dashcam footage of a car plunging over a bridge is just the beginning of a life and death struggle to free the driver from the burning wreck.

title: First on Scene
description: A man is struck by a truck in what appears to be a fatal collision; emergency responders are stunned when the man suddenly springs back to life and attempts to steal a nearby van.

title: First on Scene
description: Emergency workers respond to reports of a person climbing high in construction site scaffolding; in an unexpected twist, they struggle to convince the naked man to return to earth.

title: First on Scene
description: A fleet of first responders mobilize when a deranged man climbs a high-voltage power pylon; witnessing the heart-stopping moment that he does the unthinkable.

title: First on Scene
description: Two video journalists suddenly lose contact with each other during a deadly mass shooting at a nightclub; witnessing their heart-wrenching search for each other.

title: First on Scene
description: Courageous passers-by selflessly risk their lives to alert high-rise apartment residents to a fast-moving inferno.
